name: cronalert-mcp
description: Manage uptime monitors, check results, and incidents from Claude. Create monitors, check status, respond to outages.

tools.name: list_monitors
tools.description: List all uptime monitors with status and response times

tools.name: get_monitor
tools.description: Get details for a specific monitor

tools.name: update_monitor
tools.description: Update a monitor's settings or pause/resume it

tools.name: get_check_results
tools.description: Get check history with uptime percentage and response times

tools.name: get_monitor_incidents
tools.description: Get incidents for a specific monitor

tools.name: list_incidents
tools.description: List all active incidents across all monitors

tools.name: add_incident_update
tools.description: Post a status update on an active incident

tools.name: get_incident_updates
tools.description: Get status updates for a specific incident

tools.name: import_monitors
tools.description: Import monitors from other monitoring services (UptimeRobot, Pingdom, etc.)

api_key.title: CronAlert API Key
api_key.description: Get your API key from cronalert.com/app/settings/api-keys
